reports.title: ACADIA HEALTHCARE ANNOUNCES THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS AND RAISES FULL YEAR 2026 FINANCIAL GUIDANCE

guidance.heading: 2026 Financial Guidance
section: Acadia today updated its financial guidance for 2026, as follows:

Full Year 2026November Guidance Range | Full Year 2026July Guidance Range
Revenue | $3.44 to $3.46 billion | $3.40 to $3.45 billion
Adjusted EBITDA | $615 to $625 million | $590 to $615 million
Adjusted earnings per diluted share | $1.70 to $1.80 | $1.45 to $1.60
Operating Cash Flow | $375 to $400 million | $350 to $400 million
Capital expenditures | $210 to $230 million | $235 to $255 million
The Company’s guidance does not include the impact of any future acquisitions, divestitures, transaction, legal and other costs or non-recurring legal settlements expense.
